title: AOCS subsystem interfaces and deployment - derived example requirements
coverage: Covers the instantiated root, eight functional thread declarations, two modes, device interfaces, explicit internal functional connections, process-boundary wiring and processor/bus bindings.
This is a structural design example with incomplete internal delegation, not a closed-loop satellite controller.
limitations: The root instantiates thread types, not software_aocs thread implementations; periods, deadlines and execution times of the unselected .impl classifiers are deliberately not imposed.

The model includes only six connections inside the process. Boundary sensor/control/telemetry connections do not establish complete routes to every internal thread. The telemetry sensor-input TODO is not converted into a new requirement.
The telemetry force_command direction and the telecommand power_status_TRU spelling are inconsistent with neighboring declarations; neither is imposed as a normative interface requirement.
No control laws, failure thresholds, recovery guards, real-time feasibility or mission-safety guarantees are inferred. Existing OSATE validation is not a pass.
The upstream AOCS prototype describes CSP/FSP modes and excludes orbit control, whereas this AADLib root has NM/SM and an OCF thread. Its numerical prototype requirements therefore are not imported.
original_requirement_status: The AADLib README names the historical ETH AOCS Framework design-document website. The author-maintained project site and its document archive were read. They are domain/framework design material; a version-pinned original requirement set for this exact AADLib root has not been established.

requirements.text: The AOCS subsystem shall contain one AOCS processing process, one LEON2-derived processor, eight sensor devices, three actuator devices, a satellite central-computer device, a watchdog device, an internal DMA bus and a satellite OBDH bus.

requirements.text: The AOCS processing process shall be bound to the dedicated LEON2-derived processor; the processor shall declare a round-robin scheduling protocol.

requirements.text: The eight sensor devices shall be FSS, CSS, SPS, ES, MGM, GYR, STR and GPS. Each shall expose an outgoing typed measurement data port, an incoming power-status data port, an incoming sensor-reconfiguration data port and a required DMA-bus access.

requirements.text: The process shall contain eight functional thread instances: attitude control (ACF), orbit control (OCF), telecommand processing (TCP), telemetry processing (TMP), failure detection/isolation (FDR), failure recovery (FR), reconfiguration (Reconfig), and manoeuvre execution (ME). The root shall reference their thread types, without selecting the separately declared .impl classifiers.

requirements.text: The process shall declare normal mode as initial and safe mode as the second mode. Forcing_Safe_Mode shall change normal to safe, and Getting_Back_To_Normal_Mode shall change safe to normal.

requirements.text: Orbit control, failure detection/isolation, failure recovery and manoeuvre execution shall be active only in normal mode. Attitude control, telecommand processing, telemetry processing and reconfiguration shall have no mode restriction at their subcomponent declarations.

requirements.text: The failure-detection/isolation thread interface shall expose inputs for gyroscope attitude, fine-sun direction, attitude window, eight typed sensor measurements and check thresholds, together with a watchdog-event output and an anomaly-detected input. This specifies the interface only; no detection algorithm is defined.
